section-title.purpose: The titles of the two form groups.

control.purpose: Native text, date, time, and textarea controls.

hint.purpose: Small practical text beside the form.

motion.name: waiting-breath
motion.purpose: The waiting brush changes opacity from 0.6 to 0.3 at its midpoint. Disabled for reduced motion.

motion.name: scroll
motion.purpose: State changes scroll the workspace into view. Reduced motion restores auto scrolling.

components.name: Primary action
components.description: The full-width action at the end of the form.
components.css: .ds-primary { color: var(--ink, #303b31); cursor: pointer; border: 1px solid var(--accent, #4c6047); border-radius: 3px; background: transparent; min-height: 44px; } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #4c6047); outline-offset: 5px; } .ds-primary:disabled { opacity: .6; cursor: wait; } .ds-primary { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; width: 100%; padding: 16px 20px; background: var(--accent, #4c6047); color: #fffef5; font: 16px system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-primary:hover { background: #384d34; }

components.name: Place search action
components.description: A secondary bordered action beside birthplace search.
components.css: .ds-search { color: var(--ink, #303b31); cursor: pointer; border: 1px solid var(--accent, #4c6047); border-radius: 3px; background: transparent; min-height: 44px; } .ds-search:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #4c6047); outline-offset: 5px; } .ds-search:disabled { opacity: .6; cursor: wait; } .ds-search { font: 14px system-ui, sans-serif; padding: 10px 14px; flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-search:hover { background: #d6dccb; }

components.name: Return action
components.description: A quiet return from the waiting or reading state.
components.css: .ds-return { color: var(--ink, #303b31); cursor: pointer; border: 1px solid var(--accent, #4c6047); border-radius: 3px; background: transparent; min-height: 44px; } .ds-return:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #4c6047); outline-offset: 5px; } .ds-return:disabled { opacity: .6; cursor: wait; } .ds-return { font: 14px system-ui, sans-serif; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line, #a5ac9b); border-radius: 0; padding: 12px 0; margin: 20px 0; background: transparent; } .ds-return:hover { background: transparent; border-color: var(--ink, #303b31); }

components.name: Birthplace result
components.description: One readable, left-aligned choice in birthplace results.
components.css: .ds-place { color: var(--ink, #303b31); cursor: pointer; border: 1px solid var(--accent, #4c6047); border-radius: 3px; background: transparent; min-height: 44px; } .ds-place:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #4c6047); outline-offset: 5px; } .ds-place:disabled { opacity: .6; cursor: wait; } .ds-place { font: 14px/1.5 system-ui, sans-serif; text-align: left; padding: 12px; border-color: var(--line, #a5ac9b); background: #f0f1e6; } .ds-place:hover { background: #d6dccb; }

components.name: Labeled text field
components.description: Visible label, native input, and small supporting guidance.
components.html: Choose your birthplace from the results.
components.css: .ds-field { background: var(--paper, #e8e9de); color: var(--ink, #303b31); } .ds-label { display: block; font: 14px/1.45 system-ui, sans-serif; margin: 19px 0 8px; } .ds-input { display: block; width: 100%; min-width: 0; border: 1px solid var(--line, #a5ac9b); border-radius: 3px; background: #f4f4eb; padding: 12px 13px; font: 16px/1.45 system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--ink, #303b31); caret-color: var(--accent, #4c6047); min-height: 48px; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #65705e; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: var(--accent, #4c6047); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #4c6047); outline-offset: 5px; } .ds-help { font: 13px/1.55 system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--muted, #596251); margin: 9px 0 0; }

components.name: Native time choices
components.description: Exact, ranged, and unknown time remain explicit native radio options.
components.html: Birth time
components.css: .ds-time { background: var(--paper, #e8e9de); color: var(--ink, #303b31); } .ds-time-label { display: block; font: 14px/1.45 system-ui, sans-serif; margin: 19px 0 8px; } .ds-choices { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 10px 20px; margin-bottom: 15px; } .ds-choice { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; margin: 0; min-height: 40px; font: 14px/1.45 system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-choice input { accent-color: var(--accent, #4c6047); width: 17px; height: 17px; flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-choice input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #4c6047); outline-offset: 5px; }

components.name: Quiet navigation
components.description: The small home link and italic phrase used above the surface.
components.html: pusto.shA moment to listen
components.css: .ds-header { max-width: 1440px; margin: auto; padding: 30px 6vw; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 24px; background: var(--paper, #e8e9de); color: var(--muted, #596251); font: 14px/1.5 system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-home { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; text-underline-offset: .25em; letter-spacing: .03em; } .ds-home:hover { color: #172a12; } .ds-home:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #4c6047); outline-offset: 5px; } .ds-header-phrase { font-style: italic; font-family: Georgia, serif; } @media (max-width: 760px) { .ds-header { padding: 22px 7vw; } .ds-header-phrase { font-size: 13px; } }

components.name: Reading and qualification
components.description: Plain serif prose followed by a visible sans-serif qualification. Sample prose is illustrative.
components.html:
For you

Your reading appears here as plain paragraphs, with space to pause between thoughts.

Anything that depends on a precise time will remain tentative.
components.css: .ds-reading { border-top: 1px solid var(--line, #a5ac9b); padding-top: 8px; background: var(--paper, #e8e9de); color: var(--ink, #303b31); font-family: Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif; } .ds-reading-title { font-size: 36px; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: -.02em; margin: 22px 0 26px; } .ds-reading-title:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #4c6047); } .ds-reading-paragraph { font-size: 19px; line-height: 1.85; margin: 0 0 24px; } .ds-qualification { font: 14px/1.7 system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--muted, #596251); border-top: 1px solid var(--line, #a5ac9b); padding-top: 22px; } @media (max-width: 760px) { .ds-reading-paragraph { font-size: 18px; line-height: 1.8; } }

components.name: Form alert
components.description: A focused error message with a rust-colored upper rule.
components.html: Find and choose your birthplace before continuing.
components.css: .ds-error { background: var(--paper, #e8e9de); font: 15px/1.55 system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--error, #8c392c); padding: 14px 0; margin: 0 0 14px; border-top: 1px solid var(--error, #8c392c); } .ds-error:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #4c6047); }

narrative.overview:
Oracle carries pusto.sh's quiet olive identity into a form and an uninterrupted reading. Pale paper, dark olive ink, generous space, and the existing brush circle give it a restrained, personal character. The serif voice welcomes and reads; familiar native controls make the task clear.

This document describes only the `oracle/` surface, as implemented in `index.html`, `oracle.css`, and `oracle.js`. It records the existing design, not a deployment status or a site-wide redesign.
keyCharacteristics: A flat, muted olive palette with fine rules.
Serif introduction and prose; system sans-serif controls and guidance.
The existing `assets/circle.svg` brush as the shared identity asset.
Plain reading text with visible qualifications and a return to the form.
dos: **Do** preserve the quiet olive palette and the existing brush asset.
**Do** keep serif reading text distinct from sans-serif controls and guidance.
**Do** retain visible labels, native control behavior, keyboard focus, and reduced-motion support.
**Do** present uncertainty beside the reading in plain language.
donts: **Don't** add shadows, gradients, or card framing to this flat form and reading surface.
**Don't** turn the reading into a dashboard of charts, badges, or decorative widgets.
**Don't** hide qualifications in hover-only content or replace unknown birth time with a precise-looking value.
